use.flag: Enable GUI frontends: Streamlit web UI, PyWebView desktop window, Textual TUI

pkgmetadata.longdescription: GenericAgent is a minimalist self-evolving autonomous agent framework. Starting from a 3.3K-line seed, it grows a skill tree to achieve full system control while using 6x fewer tokens than comparable agents. It supports multiple LLM backends and frontends including a CLI, Streamlit web UI, PyWebView desktop app, Textual TUI, and Telegram bot.
